whatDistributionForQueryProduces.output: { mean, median, stdev } of a derived value series from FG outcomes

valueSeries.spread: margin h-a or a-h by teamSide (line NOT applied)
valueSeries.teamTotal: h or a by teamSide (line/totalSide NOT applied)
valueSeries.raceTo: no outcomes series — falls through to null/projection

whatDistributionForQueryProduces.implication: All alt lines sharing (kind, teamSide) on the same outcomes object need ONE distributionForQuery; cover hit thresholds are separate (coverHitRates / coverQueryHits).

baseDrawStructure.note: Full-game score pairs only. No period-specific draws stored on CoachGameSimEntry.

marketClassification.detail: Hit = compare h vs a on each FG draw. dist stats = mean of 0/1 by teamSide.
Value series = margin (h-a or a-h) identical for all lines on a teamSide. Threshold (line) only changes cover hit rate, not mean/median/stdev of margin.
Value series = h+a identical for all total lines and over/under. Line/side only affect cover hits.
Value series = home or away FG scores. Line/over-under only affect cover hits.

No H1 draws in outcomes. periodScoresForDraw scales FG draws with Math.random() noise (±7%) each call — not a pure function of base draws. coverQueryHits for period ≠ FG. distributionForQuery still incorrectly uses FG series (ignores period).
Same as halves: derived via periodScoresForDraw + Math.random; not stored in base 10K. Unsupported period×sport → NaN (no FG fallback).
raceToHits uses Math.random walk; distributionForQuery returns null stats for raceTo.
